bagPolicy.summary: The FAQ contradicts itself: it says backpacks may be searched and escorted to coat check, while its prohibited list says no backpacks. Leave backpacks behind or confirm the show’s rule directly; luggage is prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Street spaces are limited; the venue lists nearby paid lots and garages in its directions guide.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The FAQ says rides are available on Market Street but does not designate an official rideshare pickup or drop-off point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food is sold at every concert, and the bar advertises $8 featured drinks. Outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The entrance is accessible, ADA viewing is at the rear of the floor, and the lobby restroom has accessible stalls. Accessible seats can be selected on the event’s official ticket page.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests cannot leave and return after their tickets are scanned, except through the venue smoking section.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call opens 90 minutes before each show; bring photo ID, the purchasing credit card and the AXS confirmation number. Most other tickets use AXS mobile scanning.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors usually open one hour before showtime but vary by concert. The venue advises against lining up before the stated door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
